raw_resume.summary: Software Engineer (Full Stack) with 5+ years of professional experience designing and building scalable backend services and frontend applications. Seeking the Software Development Engineer II role to deepen expertise in distributed systems, algorithms, and system architecture.

bullets: Built Spring Boot services for shipment tracking that process 2 million events a day from Kafka, demonstrating experience with distributed event-driven systems.
Developed React and TypeScript screens for the dispatcher console used by 300 operators, delivering full-stack features end-to-end.
Containerised 5 services with Docker and deployed them to Kubernetes on AWS, managing operational deployment and scaling.
Added contract tests between the tracking API and the console, catching 9 breaking changes before release and strengthening system reliability.
Automated 80 checkout regression tests with Selenium and Java, establishing testing standards and source control practices.
Ran JMeter load tests for the festive-sale release, validating system performance under production-like conditions.

projects.name: A11y Audit Helper
projects.description: React and TypeScript browser extension that flags missing alt text and low-contrast elements on a page, improving web accessibility compliance.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with algorithm design and complexity analysis (e.g. LeetCode, system design interviews) to directly address the JD's emphasis on algorithms.
Deepen your distributed systems knowledge by studying consensus protocols, eventual consistency, and fault tolerance — then document a project or role achievement that demonstrates this.
Lead or participate in formal code review processes and document your design pattern usage (e.g. Factory, Observer, Strategy) in a project or role description.
Pursue a system design project (e.g. a scalable cache, message queue, or multi-tenant API) that showcases your ability to architect for reliability and scaling, then add it to your resume.
raw_resume.growth_note: Your profile shows strong full-stack and operational skills (Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, testing), but the JD explicitly requires 2+ years of system design and architecture experience, plus demonstrated expertise in algorithms and design patterns. Your current bullets focus on implementation and deployment rather than architectural decisions or algorithmic problem-solving. To be competitive for SDE II, gain and document experience in system design, scalability trade-offs, and algorithm optimization.
